title: From wires to kets, integers and records
objectives: Translate bit labels into amplitude indices.
Distinguish drawing order from measurement wiring.
prerequisites: Chapters 3–6: tensor products, unitary gates, joint-state order, coherent control and measurement.

quizzes.question: What is the amplitude index for |101⟩ in |x1 x0 y⟩ order?
Does reverse_bits=True on the circuit drawing physically swap qubits?
options: No, it only changes the drawing.
feedback: A display option is not a SWAP operation.
Correct: the circuit action stays the same.
Gate matrices do not change under that drawing option.
